formulas.ascii: c_i = sum_j w_ij (x_i - x_j)^2 / sigma^2, over active neighbors j; sigma^2 is the population variance of the analysis rows, so this is the sum of squared differences of standardized values. Row-standardized weights are divided by what remains of the row sum, so masked neighbors drop out. Small c_i means similar neighbors. NaN for excluded rows, for islands under islands = exclude (0 under keep) and for a constant variable. There is no analytic p-value or class.
